candidates.title: SWE-Pruner: Self-Adaptive Context Pruning for Coding Agents
candidates.abstract: LLM agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in software development, but their performance is hampered by long interaction contexts, which incur high API costs and latency. While various context compression approaches such as LongLLMLingua have emerged to tackle this challenge, they typically rely on fixed metrics such as PPL, ignoring the task-specific nature of code understanding. As a result, they frequently disrupt syntactic and logical structure and fail to retain critical implementation details. In this paper, we propose SWE-Pruner, a self-adaptive context pruning framework tailored for coding agents. Drawing inspiration from how human programmers"selectively skim"source code during development and debugging, SWE-Pruner performs task-aware adaptive pruning for long contexts. Given the current task, the agent formulates an explicit goal (e.g.,"focus on error handling") as a hint to guide the pruning targets. A lightweight neural skimmer (0.6B parameters) is trained to dynamically select relevant lines from the surrounding context given the goal. Evaluations across four benchmarks and multiple models validate SWE-Pruner's effectiveness in various scenarios, achieving 23-54% token reduction on agent tasks like SWE-Bench Verified while even improving success rates, and up to 14.84x compression on single-turn tasks like LongCodeQA with minimal performance impact.
candidates.reason: SWE-Prunerはコーディングエージェントの長いリポジトリ観測文脈を、現在の修正目標から生成したfocus hintと0.6Bの軽量skimmerで行単位に選択・圧縮する。トークン単位削除で構文を壊す従来圧縮と異なり、SWE-Bench Verifiedでトークン23〜38%削減し成功率を1.2〜1.4ポイント改善、SWE-QAでは最大54.4%削減。LLMのプリフィル入力トークン量・API費用を減らす推論時コンテキスト圧縮であり、推論効率サーベイ対象。
candidates.library_body_check: fulltext_checked; arXiv公式PDF §3〜4でタスク依存の行選択と0.6B skimmer、§5.1 Table 1でSWE-Bench Verifiedの23〜38%トークン削減と成功率改善、Table 3で50件subsetの成功率64%・0.670M tokens対無圧縮62%・0.972M、§5.2 Table 4で長文コードQAの最大14.84倍実効圧縮を確認。主にエージェント観測文脈の圧縮で、KVカーネルそのものではない。

candidates.title: Guiding LLMs The Right Way: Fast, Non-Invasive Constrained Generation
candidates.abstract: To ensure that text generated by large language models (LLMs) is in an expected format, constrained decoding proposes to enforce strict formal language constraints during generation. However, as we show in this work, not only do such methods incur performance overhead during generation, but many of them also significantly impair task accuracy, if they do not correctly align the underlying LLM sub-word vocabularies with external constraints. To address this, we present a novel decoding algorithm, DOMINO, that can enforce constraints in a fully subword-aligned fashion, while leveraging pre-computation and speculative decoding to achieve virtually no overhead and in some cases even almost 2$\times$ speedup over unconstrained decoding -- thereby outperforming existing approaches by a wide margin.
candidates.reason: DOMINOはLLMのサブワード語彙と文脈自由文法の終端記号の境界不一致により、制約付き生成が出力品質とスループットを落とす問題を解決する。文字単位オートマトンから語彙整列済みサブターミナル木を事前構築し、オンラインパーサで合法トークンを高速選択、制約付きの先読み復号を併用する。Mistral-7BのJSON形式GSM8Kで単純制約の30.8%から最小侵襲方式41.8%へ回復し、無制約比ほぼゼロの追加負荷から最大約2倍の高速化を示す、生成時の実行アルゴリズム研究。
candidates.library_body_check: fulltext_checked; arXiv公式PDF §2でサブワード境界の不整合がGSM8K正答率を無制約41.5%から30.8%へ落とすこと、§3で文字scanner・vocabulary-aligned subterminal tree・online parserによるDOMINO、§4の評価で制約付き生成の品質・スループット比較を確認。LLM生成デコーダの推論時処理が最終適用先。
